title: Master System / Game Gear / SG-1000 cartridge
description: A cartridge of 16 KB pages: pages 0-2 in slots 0-2 at power-on, where flow is followed from the reset, IRQ and NMI vectors. The VDP, PSG and controller ports and the mapper's registers by name (the Game Gear's own ports for a Game Gear; the SG-1000 has no mapper, memory control, I/O control or V counter, and its SC-3000 8255 at $DC-$DF), written in WLA-DX.
